items.title: Build the /roadmap build-status page
items.summary: A dependency-free page at /roadmap, backed by data/roadmap.json, that renders one table per status plus in-flight section tables. The living record of work on this project.
items.notes: Exists so work is tracked in one honest place before anything depends on it — storage is a single JSON file the assistant edits directly (no DB, no admin UI, no auth, by design). Kept dependency-free on purpose: no CDN, no build step, so it still opens in five years. Verified the /roadmap route returns 200 and /roadmap.json parses. Observed conflict I did NOT silently resolve: the pasted rules 3-4 (done newest-first, everything else oldest-first as a queue) contradict the follow-up 'order everything newest at the top' — I implemented rules 2-4 as written and flagged it for a ruling rather than quietly picking one. Ruling (2026-08-30): user chose to keep rules 2-4 as the default; header-click sort still overrides per-table (rule 5). Resolved with no code change.

items.title: Wellness Project exercise backfill
items.summary: Flask app finds empty Wellness Project (Health Connect) strength workouts and backfills them from the matching Speediance session's exercises, via an OAuth MCP client. Scheduled daily scan plus a manual button.
items.affects: wellness_client.py, reconcile.py, app.py (/wp/* routes), templates/wp_reconcile.html, tests/
items.notes: Design spec + 9-task TDD plan written and committed (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-30-wellness-project-backfill-design.md, docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-30-wellness-project-backfill.md). Execution: subagent-driven development. Key design finding: Wellness Project exposes no REST API and no API key — its MCP endpoint IS the API, gated by OAuth (authorization_code + PKCE + refresh_token; no machine grant), so the app must connect once in a browser then refresh silently. The date+calories match key was exact across the live 90-day window. Built 2026-08-30 via 9-task subagent-driven development, all tasks reviewed clean and merged to main; automated suite 207 green (2 pre-existing unrelated e2e failures). The independent review gate caught and fixed two real bugs the plan itself had baked in: a CSRF state-expiry bypass (a stale OAuth `state` was still accepted) and a silent SSE data-loss (the MCP parser returned the first `data:` event, so a legal notification-before-result stream yielded an empty result). Two controller rulings: a dedup guard so one Speediance session can't fill two workouts, and a provenance note set directly rather than appending to the Health-Connect note. STILL WORKING, not done: the live OAuth Connect flow and the first real backfill cannot be automated — they need a one-time browser Connect at /wp/reconcile. Flips to done once that live smoke test passes.
